# ONLYOFFICE DocSpace: API Reference

> Integrate ONLYOFFICE DocSpace into your application to interact with its REST API using GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE methods.

Links below point to the Markdown version of each page. For the other sections of this documentation, see the [index](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/llms.txt).

## Get started

- [Introducing ONLYOFFICE DocSpace](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/basic-concepts.md): ONLYOFFICE DocSpace is a collaborative cloud platform that allows users to edit and collaborate on documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, and forms in customizable rooms. It provides the following features:
- [Get ONLYOFFICE DocSpace](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/get-onlyoffice-docspace.md): ONLYOFFICE offers these ways to access and use DocSpace:
- [Authentication](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication.md): Interacting with the DocSpace API requires authentication. ONLYOFFICE offers several methods to authenticate your requests. The chosen authentication method depends on your application's purpose, its users, and the features it requires.
- [OAuth 2.0](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/oauth2.md): The OAuth 2.0 authorization protocol enables a third-party application to obtain limited access to an HTTP service.
- [Creating OAuth app](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/oauth2/creating-oauth-app.md): To create a new OAuth application, send a POST request to the api/2.0/clients address.
- [Editing OAuth app](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/oauth2/editing-oauth-app.md): For security purposes, DocSpace allows you to edit only the App name, App icon, Description, and Authentication method settings. Future versions of DocSpace might expand this list to include other settings.
- [Using the Auth button](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/oauth2/auth-button.md): With your OAuth app configured, you can now embed the Auth button on your website to let users sign in with DocSpace.
- [Developer token](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/oauth2/developer-token.md): You can generate a developer access token that allows you to make API calls without authorization. To obtain access tokens for other users, apply the standard OAuth flow.
- [Authorization flow](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/oauth2/authorization-flow.md): When a user clicks the authorization link, any of these four scenarios can occur:
- [Viewing active authorizations](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/oauth2/viewing-active-authorizations.md): Each user can see the applications they have granted access to on the profile page, on the Authorized apps tab.
- [OpenID Connect](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/openid-connect.md): OpenID Connect (OIDC) is an authentication protocol based on OAuth 2.0, which simplifies the way to verify the identity of users and obtain basic profile information in a secure and standardized way. It is commonly used in scenarios where applications need to authenticate users and establish their identity.
- [API keys](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/api-keys.md): API keys are simple tokens used to authenticate API requests. They act as a unique identifier and secret that confirms the identity of the calling application or service.
- [Personal access tokens](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/personal-access-tokens.md): Follow these steps to generate a PAT and use it to authorize your DocSpace account:
- [Basic authentication](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/authentication/basic-authentication.md): The basic authentication is defined in RFC 7617 and transmits credentials as a username and password pair, encoded using Base64. The credentials are included in the Authorization header in the following format:
- [Long-running operations](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/how-it-works/long-running-operations.md): The user initiates a long-running operation by sending a request to the appropriate API endpoint, which returns an object containing information about the initiated operation. An example of such a request and response:
- [Uploading large files](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/how-it-works/uploading-large-files.md): In this article, you will learn how to upload large files to DocSpace using our API Backend.
- [Webhooks](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/how-it-works/webhooks.md): Webhooks are HTTP/HTTPS callbacks triggered by events (triggers) related to portal entities such as Users, Groups, Documents, Folders, and Rooms. DocSpace users can create, subscribe to, and configure webhooks so that events in the portal trigger actions in external services. This functionality is useful for synchronizing and tracking specific events.
- [Removed users](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/how-it-works/removed-users.md): Users removed from the DocSpace portal are specified with the LostUser constant, which is a UserInfo object in the following format:
- [SDKs](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/sdks.md): ONLYOFFICE DocSpace SDKs for integrating and managing DocSpace features within your applications.
- [C](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/sdks/csharp-get-started.md): The ONLYOFFICE DocSpace SDK for C# is a library that provides tools for integrating and managing DocSpace features within your applications.
- [Java](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/sdks/java-get-started.md): The ONLYOFFICE DocSpace SDK for Java is a library that provides tools for integrating and managing DocSpace features within your applications.
- [PHP](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/sdks/php-get-started.md): The ONLYOFFICE DocSpace SDK for PHP is a library that provides tools for integrating and managing DocSpace features within your applications.
- [Postman](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/sdks/postman-get-started.md): The ONLYOFFICE DocSpace SDK for Postman is a simple Postman Collection for integrating with the ONLYOFFICE DocSpace API.
- [Python](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/sdks/python-get-started.md): The ONLYOFFICE DocSpace SDK for Python is a library that provides tools for integrating and managing DocSpace features within your applications.
- [TypeScript](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/get-started/sdks/typescript-get-started.md): The ONLYOFFICE DocSpace SDK for TypeScript is a library that provides tools for integrating and managing DocSpace features within your applications.

## API usage

- [Create a user API key](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/create-api-key.md): Creates a user API key with the parameters specified in the request.
- [Get current user's API keys](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-api-keys.md): Returns a list of all API keys for the current user.
- [Get API key permissions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-all-permissions.md): Returns a list of all available permissions for the API key.
- [Get current user's API key](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-api-key.md): Returns information about the current user's API key.
- [Update an API key](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/update-api-key.md): Updates an existing API key changing its name, permissions, and status.
- [Delete a user API key](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/delete-api-key.md): Deletes a user API key by its ID.
- [Check authentication](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-is-authentificated.md): Checks if the current user is authenticated or not.
- [Authenticate a user](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/authenticate-me.md): Authenticates the current user by SMS, authenticator app, or without two-factor authentication.
- [Authenticate a user by code](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/authenticate-me-from-body-with-code.md): Authenticates the current user by SMS or two-factor authentication code.
- [Log out](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/logout.md): Logs out of the current user account.
- [Open confirmation email URL](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/check-confirm.md): Opens a confirmation email URL to validate a certain action (employee invitation, portal removal, phone activation, etc.).
- [Set a mobile phone](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/save-mobile-phone.md): Sets a mobile phone for the current user.
- [Send SMS code](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/send-sms-code.md): Sends SMS with an authentication code.
- [Get the backup schedule](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-backup-schedule.md): Returns the backup schedule of the current portal.
- [Create the backup schedule](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/create-backup-schedule.md): Creates the backup schedule of the current portal with the parameters specified in the request.
- [Delete the backup schedule](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/delete-backup-schedule.md): Deletes the backup schedule of the current portal.
- [Start the backup](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/start-backup.md): Starts the backup of the current portal with the parameters specified in the request.
- [Get the backup progress](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-backup-progress.md): Returns the progress of the started backup.
- [Get the backup history](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-backup-history.md): Returns the history of the started backup.
- [Delete the backup](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/delete-backup.md): Deletes the backup with the ID specified in the request.
- [Delete the backup history](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/delete-backup-history.md): Deletes the backup history from the current portal.
- [Start the restoring process](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/start-backup-restore.md): Starts the data restoring process of the current portal with the parameters specified in the request.
- [Get the restoring progress](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-restore-progress.md): Returns the progress of the started restoring process.
- [Get the number of backups](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-backups-count.md): Returns the number of backups for a period of time. The default is one month.
- [Get the backup service state](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-backups-service-state.md): Returns the backup service state.
- [Get portal capabilities](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-portal-capabilities.md): Returns the information about portal capabilities.
- [Save file edits](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/save-editing-file-from-form.md): Saves edits to a file with the ID specified in the request.
- [Start file editing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/start-edit-file.md): Informs about opening a file with the ID specified in the request for editing, locking it from being deleted or moved (this method is called by the mobile editors).
- [Start file filling](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/start-filling-file.md): Starts filling a file with the ID specified in the request.
- [Track file editing](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/track-edit-file.md): Tracks file changes when editing.
- [Open a file configuration](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/open-edit-file.md): Returns the initialization configuration of a file to open it in the editor.
- [Get file download link asynchronously](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-presigned-file-uri.md): Returns a link to download a file with the ID specified in the request asynchronously.
- [Get reference data](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-reference-data.md): Returns the reference data to uniquely identify a file in its system and check the availability of insering data into the destination spreadsheet by the external link.
- [Get users access rights to the protected file](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-protected-file-users.md): Returns a list of users with their access rights to the protected file with the ID specified in the request.
- [Get file history](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-file-history.md): Returns the list of actions performed on the file with the specified identifier.
- [Change version history](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/change-version-history.md): Changes the version history of a file with the ID specified in the request.
- [Get file versions](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-file-version-info.md): Returns the detailed information about all the available file versions with the ID specified in the request.
- [Get file download link](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-presigned-uri.md): Returns a pre-signed URL to download a file with the specified ID.
- [Check the PDF file](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/is-form-pdf.md): Checks if the PDF file is a form or not.
- [Copy a file](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/copy-file-as.md): Copies (and converts if possible) an existing file to the specified folder.
- [Create a file](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/create-file.md): Creates a new file in the specified folder with the title specified in the request.
- [Create an HTML file](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/create-html-file.md): Creates an HTML (.html) file in the selected folder with the title and contents specified in the request.
- [Create a text file](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/create-text-file.md): Creates a text (.txt) file in the selected folder with the title and contents specified in the request.
- [Delete a file](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/delete-file.md): Deletes a file with the ID specified in the request.
- [Get file information](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-file-info.md): Returns the detailed information about a file with the ID specified in the request.
- [Update a file](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/update-file.md): Updates the information of the selected file with the parameters specified in the request.
- [Get form-filling result](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-fill-result.md): Retrieves the result of a form-filling session.
- [Get changes URL](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-edit-diff-url.md): Returns a URL to the changes of a file version specified in the request.
- [Get version history](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-edit-history.md): Returns the version history of a file with the ID specified in the request.
- [Lock a file](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/lock-file.md): Locks a file with the ID specified in the request.
- [Set the Custom Filter editing mode](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/set-custom-filter-tag.md): Sets the Custom Filter editing mode to a file with the ID specified in the request.
- [Restore a file version](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/restore-file-version.md): Restores a file version specified in the request.
- [Create primary external link](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/create-file-primary-external-link.md): Creates a primary external link by the identifier specified in the request.
- [Get primary external link](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-file-primary-external-link.md): Returns the primary external link by the identifier specified in the request.
- [Get file external links](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-file-links.md): Returns the external links of a file with the ID specified in the request.
- [Set an external link](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/set-file-external-link.md): Sets an external link to a file with the ID specified in the request.
- [Set file order](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/set-file-order.md): Sets the order of the file with the ID specified in the request.
- [Set order of files](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/set-files-order.md): Sets the order of the files specified in the request.
- [Save a file as PDF](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/save-file-as-pdf.md): Saves a file with the identifier specified in the request as a PDF document.
- [Save form role mapping](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/save-form-role-mapping.md): Saves the form role mapping.
- [Get form roles](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-all-form-roles.md): Returns all roles for the specified form.
- [Perform form filling action](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/manage-form-filling.md): Performs the specified form filling action.
- [Create a file in the 'My documents' section](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/create-file-in-my-documents.md): Creates a new file in the 'My documents' section with the title specified in the request.
- [Create an HTML file in the 'My documents' section](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/create-html-file-in-my-documents.md): Creates an HTML (.html) file in the 'My documents' section with the title and contents specified in the request.
- [Create a text file in the 'My documents' section](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/create-text-file-in-my-documents.md): Creates a text (.txt) file in the 'My documents' section with the title and contents specified in the request.
- [Create file thumbnails](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/create-thumbnails.md): Creates thumbnails for the files with the IDs specified in the request.
- [Check the form draft filling](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/check-fill-form-draft.md): Checks if the current file is a form draft which can be filled out.
- [Add a file to the 'Recent' section](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/add-file-to-recent.md): Adds a file with the ID specified in the request to the 'Recent' section.
- [Change the file favorite status](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/toggle-file-favorite.md): Changes the favorite status of the file with the ID specified in the request.
- [Add template files](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/add-templates.md): Adds files with the IDs specified in the request to the template list.
- [Delete template files](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/delete-templates.md): Removes files with the IDs specified in the request from the template list.
- [Delete recent files](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/delete-recent.md): Removes files with the IDs specified in the request from the 'Recent' section.
- [Create the editing session](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/create-edit-session.md): Creates a session to edit the existing file with multiple chunks (needed for WebDAV).
- [Get the 'Recent' section](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-recent-folder.md): Returns the detailed list of files located in the 'Recent' section.
- [Get folder history](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-folder-history.md): Returns the activity history of a folder with a specified identifier.
- [Generates folder history](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/create-report-folder-history.md): Generates the activity history of a folder.
- [Get folder form filter](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-folder.md): Returns the form filter of a folder with the ID specified in the request.
- [Create a folder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/create-folder.md): Creates a new folder with the title specified in the request. The parent folder ID can be also specified.
- [Delete a folder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/delete-folder.md): Deletes a folder with the ID specified in the request.
- [Get folder information](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-folder-info.md): Returns the detailed information about a folder with the ID specified in the request.
- [Rename a folder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/rename-folder.md): Renames the selected folder with a new title specified in the request.
- [Set folder order](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/set-folder-order.md): Sets the order of a folder with ID specified in the request.
- [Get a folder by ID](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-folder-by-folder-id.md): Returns the detailed list of files and folders located in the folder with the ID specified in the request.
- [Get the folder path](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-folder-path.md): Returns a path to the folder with the ID specified in the request.
- [Get subfolders](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-folders.md): Returns a list of all the subfolders from a folder with the ID specified in the request.
- [Get new folder items](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-new-folder-items.md): Returns a list of all the new items from a folder with the ID specified in the request.
- [Get used space of files](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-files-used-space.md): Returns the used space of files in the root folders.
- [Create primary external link](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/create-folder-primary-external-link.md): Creates a primary external link by the identifier specified in the request.
- [Get primary external link](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-folder-primary-external-link.md): Returns the primary external link by the identifier specified in the request.
- [Set the folder external link](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/set-folder-primary-external-link.md): Sets the folder external link with the ID specified in the request.
- [Get the folder links](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-folder-links.md): Returns the links of the folder with the ID specified in the request.
- [Get the 'Favorites' section](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-favorites-folder.md): Returns the detailed list of files and folders located in the 'Favorites' section.
- [Get the 'My documents' section](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-my-folder.md): Returns the detailed list of files and folders located in the 'My documents' section.
- [Get the 'Private Room' section](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-privacy-folder.md): Returns the detailed list of files and folders located in the 'Private Room' section.
- [Get filtered sections](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-root-folders.md): Returns all the sections matching the parameters specified in the request.
- [Get the 'Trash' section](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-trash-folder.md): Returns the detailed list of files and folders located in the 'Trash' section.
- [Check file uploads](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/check-upload.md): Checks the file uploads to the folder with the ID specified in the request.
- [Insert a file](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/insert-file.md): Inserts a file specified in the request to the selected folder by single file uploading.
- [Upload a file](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/upload-file.md): Uploads a file specified in the request to the selected folder by single file uploading or standart multipart/form-data method.
- [Insert a file to the 'My documents' section](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/insert-file-to-my-from-body.md): Inserts a file specified in the request to the 'My documents' section by single file uploading.
- [Upload a file to the 'My documents' section](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/upload-file-to-my.md): Uploads a file specified in the request to the 'My documents' section by single file uploading or standart multipart/form-data method.
- [Get conversion status](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/check-conversion-status.md): Checks the conversion status of a file with the ID specified in the request.

The client ID cannot be modified.
- [Delete an OAuth2 client](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/delete-client.md): Permanently deletes an OAuth2 client and all associated data. All access and refresh tokens issued to this client will be invalidated. This operation cannot be undone.
- [Create a new OAuth2 client](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/create-client.md): Creates a new OAuth2 client with the specified configuration. The client will be created with the provided scopes, redirect URIs, and other settings. Returns the created client details including the generated client ID.
- [Regenerate the client secret](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/regenerate-secret.md): Generates a new client secret for the specified OAuth2 client. The old secret will be immediately invalidated. This operation should be used with caution as it requires updating the secret in all client applications.
- [Change the client activation status](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/change-activation.md): Activates or deactivates an OAuth2 client. When deactivated, the client cannot request new access tokens, but existing tokens will remain valid until they expire.
- [Revoke client consent](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/revoke-user-client.md): Revokes all user consents for the specified OAuth2 client. This will invalidate all access tokens and refresh tokens issued to this client for the current user. The user will need to re-authorize the client to access their resources.
- [Get available OAuth2 scopes](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-scopes.md): Retrieves a list of all available OAuth2 scopes for the specified tenant. The scopes define the permissions that can be requested by OAuth2 clients. The list is ordered alphabetically, with the 'openid' scope always appearing first.
- [Get client details](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/usage-api/get-client.md): Retrieves detailed information about a specific OAuth2 client including its name, description, redirect URIs, and scopes.

## Samples

- [Add members to a group](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/samples/basic-samples/add-members-to-group.md): Add one or more members to an existing group via the API.
- [Authenticate a user by code (2FA)](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/samples/basic-samples/authenticate-user-by-code.md): Authenticate a user with a one-time 2FA code via the API.
- [Authenticate a user](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/samples/basic-samples/authentication.md): Authenticate a user and verify the received token via the API.
- [Change file or folder ownership](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/samples/basic-samples/change-file-or-folder-owner.md): Transfer file or folder ownership to another user via the API.
- [Copy or move a file to a folder](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/samples/basic-samples/copy-or-move-file.md): Copy or move a file to another folder via the API.
- [Create and open a new file](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/samples/basic-samples/create-and-open-new-file.md): Create a new file in a folder and open it in the browser.
- [Create an API Key](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/samples/basic-samples/create-api-key.md): Generate an API key with specific permissions via the API.
- [Create a backup schedule](https://api.onlyoffice.com/docspace-plugin-sdk/docspace/api-backend/samples/basic-samples/create-backup-schedule.md): Create a daily backup schedule for the portal via the API.
